title: Method
description: The kind of method that produces a step's result. Eight kinds are available. Four of them are reproducible: rule and wait exactly, statistics given the same data, ml and neural at a pinned version and seed. llm and worker are variable and require a fallback. Six kinds produce a result and carry an exactness class; wait and human produce none and carry no class (ADR-0018). See docs/architecture/methods.md and ADR-0004.

variable.title: VariableMethod
variable.description: Methods whose result can differ between two runs with the same input. A step using one of these carries a fallback.

pinned.title: PinnedMethod
pinned.description: Methods that are reproducible only at a pinned model version. A step using one of these names its model.

producing.title: ProducingMethod
producing.description: Methods that produce a result. A step using one of these carries an exactness class (ADR-0018).

nonProducing.title: NonProducingMethod
nonProducing.description: Methods that produce no result: wait passes on what arrives, human is itself the authority. A step using one of these carries no exactness class (ADR-0018).

exactAdmissible.title: ExactAdmissibleMethod
exactAdmissible.description: The only methods that may produce the result of a step classed exact (ADR-0014).
